text: せっかく　じーさんに　ポケモン　もらったんだぜ！

structure.jp: じーさんに　ポケモン　もらったんだぜ！
structure.en: we got Pokémon from Gramps, after all!

patterns.name: 〜に〜をもらう
patterns.span: じーさんに　ポケモン　もらった
patterns.explanation: With もらう, に shows the person who gave it, not the one who got it; the を after ポケモン is dropped in casual speech. じーさんに　ポケモン　もらった = 'got Pokémon from Gramps'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken short form of のだ, which gives the feel of 'the thing is', and ぜ is a rough male ending. もらったんだぜ = 'we got them, after all!'.

patterns.name: せっかく〜
patterns.span: せっかく　じーさんに　ポケモン　もらった
patterns.explanation: せっかく says something took effort or is a rare chance, so it would be a waste not to use it. せっかく　もらった = 'we went to the trouble of getting them'.
